label: calibrated synthetic — not validated against real data; every constant is a verified minephys knowledge row with its citation (efficiencies from one published truck model, diesel lower heating value from a US government data page): route energy, fuel and CO2e per tonne by drivetrain on the Bingham pit road and least-energy A* routes over the real terrain
notes: Produced on the CPU by pitstudio_pipeline.haulage.a2_run (not by the GPU queue); no GPU time is used.

Supersedes the first A2 run, whose five efficiency and fuel-density constants were recipe inputs listed UNVERIFIED because the pinned minephys had no rows for them; minephys spec 001 DC-001-02 now holds them as verified rows (Lindgren et al. 2022, Table 2, p. 7; US DOE Alternative Fuels Data Center, Fuel Properties Comparison) and the run reads them from the tables.
The electricity emissions need a grid intensity that has no default, so CO2e is shown for diesel only.
